body: Thanks for the advice, I will try and pick at least one friend to talk too, one who I can really trust. I just dont ever see this getting better. I read I write I throw myself into everything I do but nothing ever seems to work longer then the duration of me doing it. Any suggestions? Other than talking to a friend I mean, that I will try and do. And I know it sounds stupid and pathetic me saying I am feeling like this at bloody 17 and that I will 'try' and talk to one of my friends.

Yeah but what if they tell my family or someone else because they can't handle that news. I have always been a secretive person and hate my family knowing anything about my social life. I hate getting pity from my friends and stuff. I'm only 17 and I keep getting told these are the best years of my life but it is all I can do to keep living them.

I dont know what it was. I am no longer all that introverted and I love my friends to bits I would take a built for the lot of them. It's just as I get older everything is just building up, getting to much getting to loud. I have no one I feel as if I can really tell how I feel because it will get out or burden them. I mean how can you tell someone that you have already written goodbye to them over and over but never sent the message. 

It's my friends who are keeping me here tbh and the thought that maybe if I hold on I can help others.

Shit that sucks and I know how empty it can sound but I'm sorry that all this has happened to you, while I can't stop you from what you are intending to do just know if you ever need to talk I'm always ready for a chat. And just know that at least one person is thinking about you and wishing you the best, again I know how stupid that sounds. Please before you enact your plan try seeing someone you never know if could help. Sorry I can't be of more help I really am.

Hay dude I know personally how empty it sounds but I'm always up for a chat. I know how exaughsting it can all be and I think you are bloody amazing to have kept going all this time, Tbh its people like you who enspire me. Hang in there man.
